name: clipzard-desktop
description: ClipZard Desktop - fully local viral clip engine
author: ClipZard <hello@clipzard.web.id>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n tsc,preload,renderer,electron -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "tsc --watch" "esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron --watch" "npm --prefix renderer run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.dev:win: concurrently -k -n tsc,preload,renderer,electron -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "tsc --watch" "esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron --watch" "npm --prefix renderer run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.clean:release: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='release'; if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); console.log('cleaned release')}"
scripts.build: tsc && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron && npm run prebuild && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: tsc && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:win:clean: npm run clean:release && npm run build:win
scripts.build:mac: tsc && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: tsc && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --external:electron && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --linux
